provenance.source_description: demo 01's PR05 scorer: score_i = f(h_state, h_question, h_card_i) over cards supplied as text, scored by cosine against a learned scale, trained on 8,336 tuples from the oracle corpus across two questions (which of the DOCTOR script's rules should answer; which of three Nouls is true), with twelve rules held out of training entirely. One Adam run (lr 0.01, minibatches of 256, 30% word dropout on alternate batches) from seeded random initialization; snapshots when the measured training clock passed 0 s, 10 s, 1 min and 5 min on an M1 Max with mlpl-repl 0.22.0. Embedding rounded to 1e-3, projections to 1e-4.
